title: Write a Makefile
summary: Rules, dependencies and a clean target.
hints: A rule looks like `target: dependencies`, followed by a line that starts with a TAB and gives the command.
In a pattern rule, `$<` is the first dependency (the `.c` file) and `$@` the target (the `.o` file).
Declare `clean` as `.PHONY` so it works even if a file called `clean` exists.
